work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Indult CCCLX grants the primicerius and participants of the chapter of S. Leone Magno at Castellana (diocese of Conversano) the rochet and violet silk mozzetta with fur trimming; intitulation, ad perpetuam formula, narrative, grant, decernentes and non obstantibus clauses and dating clause survive. Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF67495–67495; the source dating clause at LF67560–67563 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die tertia aprilis millesimo octingen- tesimo quadragesimo sexto, pontificatus Nostri anno decimo sexto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
